sections.content: Comparisons help explain the advantages and disadvantages of communication technologies. Use *más*/menos + adjective + *que*, *tan* + adjective + *como* and expressions such as *mientras* que, *sin* *embargo* and aunque to contrast ideas.

items.spanish: La videollamada es más inmediata que el correo electrónico.
items.english: Video calls are more immediate than email.

items.spanish: Una conversación presencial puede ser tan eficaz como una videollamada.
items.english: An in-person conversation can be as effective as a video call.

items.spanish: La tecnología es rápida; sin embargo, no siempre es más personal.
items.english: Technology is fast; however, it is not always more personal.

items.spanish: Mientras que algunos prefieren mensajes, otros prefieren hablar por teléfono.
items.english: While some prefer messages, others prefer to talk by phone.

sections.content: Combine a comparison with a contrast when discussing advantages and disadvantages.
